caption: The drawing depicts a central figure of a bearded man dressed in blue and red robes with white trim, standing on a pedestal against a bright blue background. Behind him is a fan-shaped golden object resembling rays or feathers, and he has a golden halo. The man holds a staff in one hand and rests the other hand on his chest. The scene is framed by a large arch decorated with gold patterns and a green border, with a garland of pink roses hanging across the upper part of the arch. At the very top center of the arch is a round face with wings. To the upper right, two winged cherubs with blue and white wings, holding white lilies, are seated on a balcony ledge; their skin tones are light and their hair brown. On the upper left side sits a large golden urn on a pedestal. The entire composition is bordered by vertical rectangular panels of red, blue, and gold, with gold ornamental highlights on columns and ledges. The background consists mainly of blue and red vertical panels with gold and brown accents. The artist's signature "LEMMON" is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Fragment of Reredos
